content: Mehkoaros me mehn Israel kan kin wia sang nimenseng lel nipwong sohte katepe oh mehn kamwomwala wasa. Tiahk en pang oh mwekid en eikek laudlahr rehrail. Re kin wiahda inou lap akan ong Asiria oh wia pesines ong mehn Isip kan.”
Mie sapwellimen KAUN-O kadip ehu me uhwong mehn Suda; e pahn pil ketin kalokehki Israel mwekid en nah aramas akan. E pahn ketin dupukohng irail mehkan me re wiadahr.
Ar pahpa kahlap Seikop peiong rie Esau nindokon ara mihmihte nan kapehd en inarao; ni Seikop eh laudla, e peiong Koht—
e peiong tohnleng men oh powehdi. E ahpw sengiseng oh peki ehu kupwuramwahu. Koht ketido rehn at pahpa kahlap Seikop nan Pedel oh mahseniong.
Iei ih KAUN-O, Koht Wasa Lapalap—KAUN-O iei lengleng me aramas pahn kaudokiong.
Eri met, kumwail kadaudok en Seikop kan, kumwail likih amwail Koht oh pwurodo reh. Kumwail en loalopwoat oh pwung, oh kanengamah awiawih amwail Koht ni sapwellime mwekid kan.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanih, “Mehn Israel kan duwehte mehn Kenan kan me likamw; re kin mwahuki pitihki aramas akan mehn tenek sapwung.
Re ahpw kin nda, ‘Se me kepwehpwe, lapalahn pai se wiadahr. Oh sohte emen kak kedipahkin kiht me se kepwehpwehkihla at widing.’
Ahpw ngehi, KAUN-O, amwail Koht me waikumwaildo sang Isip, I pahn kupwurehda pwe kumwail en pwurehng kousoan nan impwal, duwehte me kumwail kin wia ni ahnsou me I ketido rehmwail nan sapwtehno.
“I mahseniongehr soukohp kan oh ketikihongirailehr kaudiahl tohto, oh ketikihong soukohp kan kehkehlik kan pwe re en kihong nei aramas akan.

Ahpw re pwongipwongihete dikedik en eni kan nan Kilead, oh irail kan me kin pwongih dikedik kan pahn mehla. Kouwol kan kin meirongla nan Kilkal, oh pei sarawi kan wasao pahn duwehla koasoakoasoak en takai nan wasa patapat akan.”
At pahpa kahlap Seikop sopolahngehr Mesopodamia. E doadoahkohng ohl emen wasao oh apwalih nah pelin sihpw kan pwehn alehki eh pwoud.
KAUN-O ketin kadarala soukohp men pwehn kapitala mehn Israel kan sang nan ar mour en lidu nan Isip oh en apwalih irail.
Mehn Israel ahpw kahngiangidahr mehlel KAUN-O; re konehng mehla pwehki diparail kan. KAUN-O pahn ketin kaloke irail pwehki ar kasohwauwihala.
